record.reason: Primary publisher abstract: FuelProp-LM predicts multiple fuel physicochemical properties from molecular SMILES using instruction tuning and in-context learning. Four open-source LLMs were fine-tuned on 100,000 PubChem entries; evaluation covers 10 fuel-property datasets. The work concerns chemistry/QSPR capability and does not study LLM inference or serving efficiency.
record.title: Language models as QSPR predictors: Unleashing potential through in-context learning and instruction tuning
